headingText: Sec. 4-103.3. Organizer of an aggravated vehicle theft conspiracy.

blocks.text: Sec. 4-103.3. Organizer of an aggravated vehicle theft conspiracy.

blocks.label: (a)
blocks.text: (a) A person commits the offense of organizer of a vehicle theft conspiracy if:

(1) the person intentionally violates Section 4-103.2 of this Code with the agreement of 3 or more persons; and (2) the person is known by other co-conspirators as the organizer, supervisor, financier or otherwise leader of the conspiracy. (b) No person may be convicted of organizer of a vehicle theft conspiracy unless an overt act in furtherance of the agreement is alleged and proved to have been committed by him or by a co-conspirator, and the accused is part of a common plan or scheme to engage in the unlawful activity.

blocks.label: (c)
blocks.text: (c) It shall not be a defense to organizer of a vehicle theft conspiracy that the person or persons with whom the accused is alleged to have conspired:
(1) has not been prosecuted or convicted;
(2) has been convicted of a different offense;
(5) lacked the capacity to commit an offense.

blocks.label: (d)
blocks.text: (d) Notwithstanding Section 8-5 of the Criminal Code of 2012, a person may be convicted and sentenced for both the offense of organizer of a vehicle theft conspiracy and any other offense in this Chapter which is the object of the conspiracy.

blocks.label: (e)
blocks.text: (e) Organizer of a vehicle theft conspiracy is a Class X felony.
